scenes.headline: How open computer-use models click, code and call tools
scenes.sub: Holo4: a screenshot in, one action out, graded on a real desktop.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Percival! Holo four is an open family of models that drive a real computer.

scenes.text: A computer-use agent sees a screenshot, emits one action, and loops; the weights and every evaluation run are public.
scenes.mark: sees a screenshot, emits one action, and loops
scenes.say: The idea: no special interface. It sees the screen, picks one action, and repeats, and the lab opened the weights and the runs.

steps.say: The harness hands the model a screenshot of a real desktop, plus the last action's result.
The model reads the pixels and picks one action.
A click, some typed text, a line of code, or a tool call. The harness runs it.
The new screen becomes the next observation. Long tasks loop for hundreds of steps.
When it stops, a checker reads the machine's final state. That pass rate is the score.

items.say: Start with fine-tuning on a hundred and twenty seven billion tokens, mostly successful runs it generated and kept.
Then two experts: one for desktop and web, one for the terminal, tool servers and interfaces.
Merge both back into the model with equal weight and no further training. That is Holo four.

scenes.title: OSWorld 2.0 — long workflows
scenes.note: Holo4 at $1.22 a task, Opus 5.5 at $8.48
scenes.say: On the hard benchmark it beats its base, but trails the best closed model, which costs seven times as much.

scenes.label: every evaluation trajectory, with each step's reasoning, action, screenshot and verifier result
scenes.note: self-reported scores you can replay, not just trust
scenes.say: Every run is published: seven thousand three hundred and sixty six trajectories you can replay, so a self-graded score is one you can check.

scenes.label: Three checkpoints, three licences
scenes.note: the strongest weights, the 27B, are the non-commercial ones
scenes.say: Three open models, three licences. Only the weaker mixture of experts is fully open; the strongest you can download cannot be used commercially.

scenes.text: It matches the frontier on easy tasks for cents, and on hard ones trades score for a far lower price.
scenes.mark: trades score for a far lower price

recap: Screenshot in, one action out, graded by a verifier
Open weights and every run, self-reported
scenes.say: To recap: a looped screenshot agent, trained by fine-tuning and two merged experts, with open weights and every run.
